description: Non-material amendment to planning permission reference: 2023/02364/VAR dated 8th February 2024 for the "Variation of Conditions 2, 32, 34, 42 and 46 to provide minor material amendments to planning permission ref: 2021/01830/VAR dated 8th December 2022, as amended by 2023/00975/NMAT dated 16th May 2023, for the "Non-material amendment to planning permission ref: 2021/01830/VAR dated 8th December 2022 for the 'Variation of Condition 2 (approved drawings), Condition 34 (number of rooms), Condition 52 (Sustainable design and construction), Condition 53 (Carbon reduction) and Condition 57 (number of rooms), and removal of Condition 35 (breakfast room) to allow minor material amendments to planning permission ref: 2017/04216/FUL dated 29 March 2019, as amended by 2020/02512/NMAT, for the "Demolition of existing building, and redevelopment of the site to provide a hotel (Use Class C1) and retail unit at ground floor level (Use Class E(a) the display or retail sale of goods, other than hot food).' Amendments sought are for: change from 100 bed hotel to 39 bed apart-hotel (Class C1); enlargement of ground floor refuse store by 2.2m in length along the side elevation facing Bucklers Alley; excavation of a single storey basement instead of two floors; and minor adjustment of window positionings. Non-material amendment sought is the alteration of the description of development for the retail unit from Class E(a) to Class E." Amendments sought are to facilitate the inclusion of Class E(b) for the ground floor retail unit and the inclusion of an additional two apart-hotel bedrooms in the basement."  Amendments sought are alterations to the internal configuration of the new development including minor reconfiguration of the waste storage to include separated hotel and retail waste rooms; minor reconfiguration of central circulation area, including lobby access, location of accessible toilet, bike storage design; and two x new access panels on the south elevation to facilitate du
